d:
A massive, demonic beast with deep crimson skin and jagged black horns protruding from a wide skull. Glowing amber eyes with a menacing, wide-eyed expression. Massive, hulking muscular build with thick, scaled skin. Large, bat-like wings of charcoal grey and a thick, spiked tail of deep crimson. Four sharp claws on each hand.
BODY COLOR: deep crimson
